svg.text: A 2×2 KERNEL IN OPENCV: THE DILATION IS NOT REFLECTED
OpenCV's dilate takes the max over the same offsets as erode, so MORPH_OPEN and MORPH_CLOSE are not an opening and a closing
fix: cv2.dilate(mask, k, anchor=(0, 0)) reflects the offsets and gives the true results, 10 and 13 pixels
issue #23605, open since May 2023; replayed from OpenCV's source, not run
